nodes.name: predict_class
nodes.description: Classify a 30-dim breast-cancer feature vector as malignant (0) or benign (1) using the frozen XGBoost model.

features.description: 30-dim float vector following sklearn load_breast_cancer schema (mean radius ... worst fractal dimension)

nodes.failure_boundary: Fails or returns unreliable output if features length != 30, contains non-numeric values, or is far outside training scale/distribution; no input validation or confidence signal is returned.

nodes.name: predict_probability
nodes.description: Return per-class probabilities for a 30-dim feature vector, enabling confidence-aware diagnosis.
nodes.failure_boundary: Same schema/scale constraints as predict; probabilities are uncalibrated and may be overconfident on out-of-distribution inputs; no rejection threshold.

nodes.name: explain_feature_importance
nodes.description: Report the top-k most important features by XGBoost gain importance, giving global model interpretability.

top_k.description: Number of top features to return

output_schema.description: Ranked list of top-k feature names/importances by gain

nodes.failure_boundary: top_k larger than the 30 available features may error or truncate; importance is global (not per-instance) and does not explain individual predictions.

nodes.name: list_classes
nodes.description: Return the class labels the model was trained on, for schema discovery and output decoding.
nodes.failure_boundary: Static metadata; fails only if the model artifact fails to load.
